case_number: 2025 INSC 249; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. [NUMBER] OF 2025 (ARISING OUT OF SPECIAL LEAVE PETITION (CRL.) NO.4299 OF 2024)

parties.respondent: State (Govt.) Of Nct Of Delhi & ORS.

summary: Challenge to High Court order on premature release for unrelated case; suppression of critical facts about fixed 30-year sentence without remission; advocate-on-record's material misrepresentation; non-party appeal; notice issued to senior advocate; code of conduct discussion; serious misconduct in filing SLP.
final_judgment: SLP withdrawal permitted initially but order stayed; court proceedings continued against advocate for misconduct; appellant directed to surrender within three weeks; case referred for disciplinary action against counsel.
